instructions: The supplied documents are hypothetical research reports. Assess only their stated content. Document blocks are text locations, not PDF page numbers. Apply the club brief's explicit eligibility and preference rules. Return one selected candidate ID, or null when none is eligible; return every equally preferred candidate in tied_ids, including the selected candidate when tied. For a unique choice tied_ids may be empty or contain that candidate. Explain the decisive comparison and cite document/block IDs. These rules define this controlled task, not universal paper quality.
brief: The club wants a documented seed-selection error for a discussion of experimental methodology. Eligible candidates must disclose at least five seed accuracies, call the headline their mean accuracy, but set that headline to the best seed rather than the actual arithmetic mean. Peak GPU memory must be no more than 24 GB. Among eligible candidates prefer the larger headline-minus-mean gap, then lower peak GPU memory. Equal quantities tie. Select null if no candidate qualifies. A flawed report is useful for this explicitly stated discussion goal; this is not a universal scientific-merit rating.
